requirements.summary: Create a Privacy Policy page at /privacy-policy with comprehensive content covering data collection, cookies, user rights, and contact information, integrated with translations

requirements.summary: Create an Export Certification, Quality Control & Product Specifications page at /export-certification with three sections covering certifications, quality processes, and detailed product specs, integrated with translations
acceptanceCriteria: An Export Certification, Quality Control & Product Specifications page is accessible at a dedicated route (e.g., /export-certification).
The page renders within the existing site layout (nav bar + footer).
The page is organized into three clearly labeled sections: Export Certifications, Quality Control, and Product Specifications.

Product Specifications section includes detailed spec information (scientific name, form, color, moisture, packaging, shelf life, grade) for at least Moringa Powder, Moringa Leaf, Curry Leaves, and Okra.
Export Certifications section mentions at least APEDA, FSSAI, Phytosanitary Certificate, and Certificate of Origin.
All text strings are sourced from the centralized translations file and render correctly in EN, HI, and MR.
A link to this page appears in the footer.
Page styling is consistent with the site's earthy-green and warm-cream theme.

file_operations.description: Add a new 'exportCertification' section to the translations object containing all text for the Export Certification page organized into three subsections: (1) Export Certifications — covering APEDA, FSSAI, Phytosanitary Certificate, Certificate of Origin, HACCP, with purpose and buyer assurance text; (2) Quality Control — covering sourcing standards, inspection processes, packaging/storage protocols, and traceability; (3) Product Specifications — detailed spec data for Moringa Powder, Moringa Leaf/Dried, Curry Leaves, and Okra/Lady Finger including scientific name, form, color, moisture content, packaging options, shelf life, and available grades. Include translations for EN, HI, and MR.

Create a new React component for the Export Certification, Quality Control & Product Specifications page. Apply existing earthy-green and warm-cream theme styling using Tailwind classes consistent with other pages.

Add an 'Export Certification' or 'Certifications & Specs' link in the footer's quick links section that navigates to /export-certification using the router's Link component. Use the translated link label from the centralized translations system.

requirements.summary: Set up client-side routing using React Router to support new pages (/privacy-policy, /terms-and-conditions, /export-certification) while keeping / as the main landing page
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /privacy-policy renders the Privacy Policy page without a full page reload.
Navigating to /terms-and-conditions renders the Terms and Conditions page without a full page reload.
Navigating to /export-certification renders the Export Certification page without a full page reload.
The root route (/) renders the main landing page as before.
All internal links to these new pages use client-side routing (no full page reloads).
The back button in the browser navigates correctly between pages.

file_operations.description: Add react-router-dom as a dependency if not already present. This enables client-side routing for the new pages.

Refactor App.tsx to use React Router's BrowserRouter, Routes, and Route components. Define routes: / renders the existing main landing page (all current sections composed together), /privacy-policy renders PrivacyPolicyPage, /terms-and-conditions renders TermsAndConditionsPage, /export-certification renders ExportCertificationPage. Ensure the navigation bar and footer are rendered on all routes. Update any anchor-based navigation to use React Router's Link component for client-side navigation. Keep the smooth-scroll behavior for in-page section links on the landing page.
